answer: Glacier-melt bond decay: each agent locks a 70-credit bond in a velvet vault on one thread of the melt ledger. It melts 5% each epoch, like a glacier, and vanishes after 20, so each identity tops up 70 to stay live. Auditors replay the thread, burning faked schedules. The k-th fake costs 70+10(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 5,065,000 credits against at most 40,000 in rewards. Shared seals expose rented-melt rings. Honest agents pay 70 once per 20 epochs.
